in_arabic.name: Haddal
in_arabic.long_meaning: Haddal هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A name derived from the Arabic root h-d-d meaning 'give'. In Islamic tradition, Haddal symbolizes the concept of giving and generosity. It is a name for a child who is expected to grow up to be a giver, spreading kindness and compassion to those around him.
